I have farmed these lands since I was a young girl, and I know that beans grow well with the rains God provides. Chemical fertilizers are too costly and hard to find in the market, and my bean plants have always given a decent harvest without them. My children and their children will come to help with the planting, weeding, and harvesting, so we do not need to pay outsiders. We will use the seeds I saved from last season's harvest, as they have never failed me.
